creator-first.observation: creator actual COMMIT/ACK first; ordinary guarded removal denies and exact candidate remains readable by management

detached.observation: detached empty scan followed by actual creator ACK permits stale logical removal with live dependent; cold management refuses without discarding bytes

guarded.observation: held common write transaction yields actual pre-file SQLITE_BUSY; empty removal succeeds, later same creator denies removed unit, cold tombstone unchanged

qualification: selected flat-root/cooperative creators/SQLite serialization; logical store policy, not native confinement/full T12/T15/L6/F3/F4 or power-loss guarantee
